name: Agmond's End
summary: Stonevault troggs overrun Agmond's End, the ruined dwarven dig in the southern Badlands. Prospector Agmond led the search until the creatures killed him and his miners.

sections.title: A Gruesome Excavation
sections.body: Dwarven prospectors came to Agmond's End in search of ancient relics and the earth's buried history. Then troggs surged from nearby crevices and overwhelmed the miners. Agmond fell in the attack, and the site took his name. Stonevault troggs now infest the ruined dig, among shattered crates and abandoned tools.

sections.title: A Lonely Neighbor
sections.body: Near the ruined excavation, Theldurin the Lost lives at a solitary camp. The dwarf's sanity has long since frayed. Yet he remains one of the few souls willing to brave the southern desert near the doomed site.

faq.answer: Agmond was a dwarven prospector who led an excavation in the southern Badlands. Troggs emerged from underground and killed him and his expedition.
Hostile Stonevault troggs overrun the ruined dig. They killed the dwarven miners and claimed the camp and surrounding crags.
Theldurin the Lost is a hermit dwarf who keeps a camp near Agmond's End in the southern hills. He watches the barren landscape.

faq.q: Why were dwarves digging here in the first place?
faq.answer: Dwarven prospectors searched the Badlands for titan artifacts, ancient ruins, and rich mineral seams. Many underestimated the savage creatures lurking underground.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the danger in digging into ancient earthen ground without enough martial support.
